description: Figure 3(a) displays the Bit-per-Character (BPC) on the validation dataset during the training phase for the SMoE routing policy, as applied to the Mistral [27] model. The x-axis represents Training Steps, scaled logarithmically from 0 to 50 (x10³), with tick labels appearing at intervals of 10 (i.e., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). The y-axis represents BPC, scaled logarithmically from 1.25 to 2.25, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.25 (i.e., 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.25). The plot contains two lines: a yellow line with circular markers representing “XMoE Validating,” which starts at approximately 2.25 BPC and decreases to about 1.25 BPC; and a magenta line with circular markers representing “SimSMoE Validating,” which starts at approximately 2.25 BPC and decreases to about 1.25 BPC. Both lines show a rapid initial decline in BPC followed by a gradual flattening toward the end of the training steps.
